avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces maraviroc plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer significantly decreases maraviroc levels below therapeutic range
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative antibiotic if TB treatment required

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May weakly induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing maraviroc concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Monitor viral load; discuss with provider before use

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction possible; limited clinical evidence
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution and clinical monitoring

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase maraviroc levels; clinical significance unclear
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; no restriction necessary but maintain consistency

monitoring_notes: Maraviroc has good oral bioavailability with minimal food interactions. Monitor for virologic failure if CYP3A4 inducers are co-prescribed; dosage adjustment to 600 mg twice daily may be needed with CYP3A4 inhibitors.
